_comment: Aletheia wiring for Claude Code. Copy the hooks block into ~/.claude/settings.json or a project .claude/settings.json. SHADOW MODE by default: she scores and records every event and blocks nothing. Only PostToolUse on WebSearch|WebFetch is wired — that is the channel where provenance is meaningful and where her calibration is measured (incident 0.88 stop / benign 0.00 proceed).
_why_no_pretooluse: A PreToolUse Bash|Edit|Write hook is deliberately NOT wired. Agent-authored command text is a plan, not an inbound document; scoring it lexically blocks ordinary maintenance, because a CVE remediation reads exactly like the injection it fixes. Measured before removal: a Dependabot PR body scored 0.82 and would have been blocked. If you want that channel, carry taint explicitly (aletheia_taint in the payload) rather than inferring it from vocabulary — policy.py already gates tainted content reaching destructive or egress tools.
_enabling_enforcement: Set ALETHEIA_MODE=enforce in the hook environment once ~/.claude/aletheia/audit.jsonl shows an acceptable false-block rate. Review with: jq -r 'select(.would_block) | [.ts,.tool,.origin,.score,.action] | @tsv' ~/.claude/aletheia/audit.jsonl
